segments.name: Snapchat
segments.description: Snapchat is a visual messaging application with camera, messaging, map and content features, and it also sells advertising, subscriptions and AR glasses.
segments.evidence: Because our CODM evaluates financial performance on a consolidated basis, we have determined that we have a single reportable segment composed of the consolidated financial results of Snap Inc.

revenueModel.text: Advertisers pay for ads on Snapchat and subscribers pay for subscription services such as Snapchat+, Lens+ and Snapchat Platinum.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate the substantial majority of our revenue through the sale of our advertising products on Snapchat, which include Snap Ads and AR Ads, referred to as advertising revenue.

changes.text: In 2023, Snap wound down its AR Enterprise business and reduced global employee headcount.
changes.evidence: In the third quarter of 2023, we initiated the wind down of our AR Enterprise business, which included a reduction of our global employee headcount by approximately 3 % .
